posts.title: Meta Andromeda: model-system co-design for GPU ads retrieval
posts.summary: Meta describes the next generation of Andromeda, its ads retrieval engine. Model, system and GPU hardware are co-designed so every eligible ad is scored with near ranking-level model quality at retrieval scale.

posts.title: Ceph v21.2.0 'Umbrella' released as first stable release
posts.summary: Ceph Umbrella is the 21st stable release. Container images move to Rocky Linux 10, which requires x86-64-v3 CPUs, and cephadm needs Python 3.9 or newer. Check these requirements before upgrading.

posts.title: Backup vs. replication: RTO/RPO and when to use both
posts.summary: Veeam explains how backup and replication differ in recovery speed and recovery point. It also covers when to combine them to answer 'how fast can we be back, and back to what?' during an incident.
